Summary: The HotpotQA original paper reports retrieval results in the full wiki setting with MAP of 43.21%, Mean Rank of 314.05, Hits@2 of 38.67, and Hits@10 of 55.88. The paper also mentions that BM25 achieves a Mean Rank of 286.20, while DPR and MSS-DPR show higher performance metrics. The comparison indicates that dense retrieval models like DPR and MSS-DPR outperform BM25 in the full wiki setting.
